sampling.rounding: nearest original pixel; .5 toward positive infinity
sampling.sampleSelection: fixed centers only; no search for favorable pixels

colorProfilePolicy.original: Preserve all PNG bytes, iCCP/sRGB/gAMA/cHRM/cICP chunks, decompressed ICC bytes and SHA. Raw stored samples remain distinct from any derived conversion.
colorProfilePolicy.primary: Predeclared comparison space is encoded 8-bit sRGB. Before composite scoring require exact opaque RED=(255,0,0), BLUE=(0,0,255), PURPLE=(128,0,128) in this space. Same-shot candidate equivalence is supplementary and cannot bypass this exact control gate; no assumption that stored bytes equal source sRGB.
colorProfilePolicy.derived: Choose pipeline before scoring from original metadata only: valid embedded ICC requires explicit offline conversion to fixed sRGB, relative-colorimetric intent, no black-point compensation. Authenticated sRGB without conflicting tags uses raw encoded samples. Missing/invalid/conflicting/ambiguous profile or unavailable conversion is NOT OBSERVED. Record CMM/version/flags/profiles/bit depths/commands and all transformed samples separately; no resizing or manual curves.
colorProfilePolicy.exclusions: Original RGB PNGs have no observed alpha channel. Derived alpha=255 is synthetic container opacity; no native source-alpha/storage or universal compositor/DPI credit.

opaqueControlGate.failure: NOT OBSERVED for all composite facets; raw pixels/control failures remain preserved with zero composite scoring credit.
opaqueControlGate.gateOrder: Metadata-only pipeline preregistration; obtain permitted native UI/export controls; exact control gate; only then score composites. No fitting channels, choosing a favorable pipeline or retroactive v104 conversion.
